Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Spendly is an expense tracker. This page explains what personal data it stores, why, for how long, who processes it and how to have it deleted.

data.heading: What Spendly stores
data.google: If you sign in with Google: your Google account ID, name and profile picture link, and the access and ID tokens Google returns.
data.password: If you sign up with a password: a hash of it. The password itself is never stored or logged.
data.sessions: For each signed-in device: a session token, its expiry, the IP address and the browser's user agent.
data.passwordReset: If you ask to reset your password: a one-time code for the emailed link, and a record of each reset email with its language and whether it was sent.
data.attempts: Counts of sign-in, sign-up and password reset attempts per IP address, to slow down password guessing and email abuse.
data.money: Your transactions (amount, date, category and an optional note) and your categories.
data.browser: In your browser: a cookie with your time zone, to know your current day, and your theme choice.

purpose.heading: Why
purpose.text: Only to run Spendly: to sign you in, keep your data private to you and show your money. Spendly has no ads or tracking, and it doesn't sell your data or share it for marketing.

retention.heading: How long
retention.account: Your account, transactions and categories: until the account is deleted.
retention.sessions: Sessions: until you sign out, or 7 days after you last used Spendly on that device.
retention.passwordReset: Password reset: the link code for one hour or until it’s used; the email records for one day.
retention.attempts: Attempt counts: one record per IP address, reset a minute after the last attempt.
retention.browser: The time zone cookie: one year; the theme choice: until you clear your browser's data.

processors.heading: Who processes it
processors.vercel: Vercel hosts Spendly and keeps its request logs.
processors.resend: Resend delivers password reset emails to your address.
processors.google: Google, if you sign in with it: it confirms your account and shares your email, name and picture with Spendly.

contact.heading: Your data and your account
contact.text: To delete your account with all its data, sign in and press Delete account: everything is deleted at once. To get a copy of your data, or with any question, write to <link>{email}</link>.
